_comment: Single source of truth for external art. Key = the art key used by the game's art maps (ART_IMG, IMG, FAC_IMG, ...) or declared by a layer (hq_* from 90-hq-stages.js). Value = filename, resolved against art/ first and the repo root second. Two keys may point at the same file when different bundles name the same subject differently — see the aliases section. Add an entry only after the asset has passed prompt review, or after an explicit decision to ship it anyway — see accepted_with_defects. 85-art-override.js reads this file at boot and reports coverage to the console.
_aliases_comment: house_* and car_* are the legacy IMG bundle's names for subjects that ART_IMG calls starter, family, mansion, sedan, sports and suv. Both keys are listed so a screen reading either map gets the new art. IMG's remaining keys — jet, vac_beach, vac_cabin, vac_paris — have no external asset yet.

accepted_with_defects._comment: Live in assets by explicit decision, but they violate their prompt's strict exclusions. Regenerate these first when image credits allow.
accepted_with_defects.brownstone: Legible street signage, pedestrians and a taxi. Text and people are both excluded.
accepted_with_defects.ski: Translucent inset border roughly 3% in from each edge. Borders are excluded.
accepted_with_defects.studio: Isometric dollhouse cutaway on a flat dark background. Flat backgrounds are excluded.
accepted_with_defects.compound: Helipad marked with the letter H. Lettering is excluded.
accepted_with_defects.hq_1: Isometric cutaway office floor on a flat green/blue background. Same failure mode as studio. Shipped because an empty slot on stage 2 of the ladder reads as a broken build.

held.pickup: Translucent vertical bands overlaying the left and right edges, same artifact class as ski.
